title: PowderHound resort scraping config
description: One file per resort in supabase/storage/scraping-config/, read at runtime by powder-hound-go from the scraping-config Storage bucket. The scraper sections stay loose because they follow the Go ScrapingConfig struct; cams is strict.

cams.description: Cams captured on a schedule by powder-hound-go and shown on the resort page. Removing an entry stops capture; already stored images expire on the normal retention schedule.

key.description: Stable id, unique within the resort. Used in storage paths and the database, so don't rename it once images exist.

kind.description: What the cam shows. Only snow stakes for now.

label.description: Short name shown in the UI, e.g. "Snow Stake" or "Summit Snow Stake".

source.description: How a frame is captured. image: HTTP GET of a still that the provider refreshes. hls: one frame from an HLS (.m3u8) stream via ffmpeg. youtube: url is a camstreamer embed (which redirects to the current YouTube live video) or a YouTube video URL; the frame is that video's live thumbnail.

url.description: Where the frame comes from, per source.

pageURL.description: The resort's own page for this cam, linked from the UI for attribution and the live view.

clearedAt.description: Local time (America/Denver, 24h HH:MM) the stake is usually cleared, when the resort states it. Leave it out when unknown.

unofficial.description: True when the resort says this stake isn't its official snowfall measurement.
